compiled_state.title: [test-harvest-worktree]: test_ci_enforcement_skips_review_status_check -> ci enforcement no longer skips review-status check after dso.workflow migration
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** a975394b82b2094c268c2127405aa34c3b4c68e1

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior
When enforcement.strategy=ci is set in dso-config.conf, harvest-worktree.sh should exit 0 and skip the review-status check. The test test_ci_enforcement_skips_review_status_check expects exit 0 and the branch to be merged into the session.

#### Actual Behavior
FAIL: ci-enforcement commit without review-status exits 0 (99a6-f818) — expected: 0, actual: 2. FAIL: ci-enforcement branch was merged into session (99a6-f818) — expected: yes, actual: no. Sprint 3b8b migrated enforcement detection but the test still uses enforcement.strategy=ci config and the harvest script may now check dso.workflow instead.
